generated_for: Mat Manners Surfboards official named standup catalog
source: https://www.matmanners.com/shapes (official Squarespace shape list — excludes accessories, off-the-rack sized one-offs, and custom deposits)

brands.name: Mat Manners Surfboards
brands.short_description: Hand-shaped performance and big-wave surfboards by Mat Manners in Margaret River, Western Australia — shortboards, grovelers, step-ups, and rhino chasers from the workshop on Auger Way West.

models.name: Best Mate
models.description: A super hi-performance all round short board, for all types of waves — your Best Mate. Offered from 4'10" to 7'0" as a thruster (FCS II / Futures) and best in 2–6ft waves.

models.name: Keeper
models.description: Hi-performance small wave board, with more volume and shorter than your all-rounder. Sizes 4'10" to 7'0", thruster or 5-fin (FCS II / Futures), built for smaller waves.

models.name: Droid
models.description: Super quick board that drives hard and holds its lines. Sizes 4'10" to 7'0", thruster or 5-fin (FCS II / Futures), for small to medium surf.

models.name: River
models.description: The River is fast and smooth down the line, the flow-rider. Such a fun easy board to ride. Sizes 4'10" to 7'0", twin / thruster / 5-fin (FCS II / Futures), for small waves.

models.name: Rondog
models.description: Our big wave boards are tested in the heaviest waves Australia has to offer. Tried and proven over the last 30 years by the best big wave surfers around. Sizes 7'0" to 10'6", thruster or 5-fin (FCS II / Futures).

models.name: Selamt Datang
models.description: Our step up board has proven a winner all through Australia, Indo and the world. Ride it 3" or more longer than your standard shortboard, thruster or 5-fin (FCS II / Futures), best in 4–6ft.

models.name: Magic Carpet
models.description: This board will motivate you and get your stoke back when the swell drops. Very loose and fun to ride. PU or EPS available. Sizes 4'10" to 6'6", thruster or 5-fin (FCS II / Futures), for tiny to small waves.

models.name: Orc
models.description: The Ork is the answer to the big guy wanting a board he can shred on. Volume and curves in all the right places. Sizes 6'6" to 7'6", thruster or 5-fin (FCS II / Futures), for all-round conditions.
